hints.text: Iterate through the array from index 0 to n - 2.

hints.title: Bitwise OR
hints.text: For each index i, compute nums[i] | nums[i + 1].

hints.title: Array Construction
hints.text: Append each computed value to form the resulting array of length n - 1.
